Desktop Organizer

DesktopDüzen

Organize your Mac desktop into interactive, customizable zones pinned to your wallpaper.

DesktopDüzen brings Stardock Fences style organization to macOS. Tidy loose clutter into File Zones backed by real folders that update live with Finder, link Folder Zones for quick access, and launch apps in 1 click from App Zones. Includes 27 themes with liquid glass, fully transparent zones whose labels turn black or white to match your wallpaper, themeable clock, calendar and system widgets, Quick Look previews, and smart auto-sort rules with a preview before anything moves. It runs quietly from the menu bar, stays out of the Dock and Cmd-Tab, and never takes your keyboard shortcuts away from the app you are using.

Swift AppKit & SwiftUI Desktop Canvas Live Folder Updates Local Privacy Menu Bar App

OUR ARCHITECTURAL PILLARS

Six core tenets built into every application.

Every tool in the suite is built adhering to the same uncompromising standards of performance, user privacy, and desktop independence.

01 / PERFORMANCE

Native and Blazing Fast

Written in Swift and Rust instead of resource-heavy web runtimes. Fully optimized to leverage Apple Silicon hardware acceleration.

02 / PRIVACY

Private by Default

Your documents, caches, and clipboard data never leave your computer. No telemetry, user profiling, or compulsory accounts.

03 / EXPERIENCE

Authentic macOS Design

Conforms to macOS Human Interface Guidelines with genuine glass effects, dark/light theme switching, and native keyboard shortcuts.

04 / TRANSPARENCY

Open Source & Free

Transparent source code hosted publicly on GitHub. Free of forced paywalls, recurring subscriptions, or invasive ads.

05 / EFFICIENCY

Low Memory & Battery Friendly

Minimal RAM overhead and idle CPU footprints ensure your MacBook's battery life is respected all day long.

06 / AUTOMATION

Agent and CLI Ready

Equipped with command-line tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and scripting hooks for seamless AI agent automation.
